nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Root Cargo workspace manifest defining the org2 Tauri desktop binary and its ~20+ internal crates (agent-core, database, browser, ui-indexer, etc.), plus shared dependency versions, build profiles, and cargo-machete false-positive allow-list for crates only referenced via the tauri::generate_handler! macro.
nodes.languageNotes: Cargo workspace manifest: [workspace.dependencies] centralizes shared version pins for member crates, and [package.metadata.cargo-machete] documents an allow-list needed because macro-expanded Tauri command registration is invisible to unused-dependency linting.

nodes.name: Info.plist
nodes.summary: macOS Info.plist declaring TCC usage-description strings (microphone and speech recognition) required for the WKWebView to request audio permissions when the app is built as a signed .app bundle.
nodes.languageNotes: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription only takes effect inside a bundled .app; `tauri dev` runs a bare binary that cannot request TCC permissions.

nodes.name: entitlements.plist
nodes.summary: macOS hardened-runtime entitlements for the main app: allows JIT/unsigned executable memory for the JS engine, disables library validation for sidecar/plugin loading, disables the App Sandbox for full filesystem access, and grants microphone/network access.
nodes.languageNotes: App Sandbox is explicitly disabled to allow unrestricted filesystem access similar to VSCode/Cursor, trading sandbox isolation for editor-like capabilities.

nodes.name: insta.yaml
nodes.summary: Configuration for the `insta` Rust snapshot-testing crate, setting new-snapshot update mode and fail-fast glob matching for the workspace's test suite.

nodes.name: provider-key-check.example.json
nodes.summary: Example configuration for the bin-provider-key-check utility crate, listing the environment variable names used to validate API keys/session tokens for each supported AI agent/provider (Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, Kiro, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Azure, etc.).

nodes.name: rust-analyzer.toml
nodes.summary: Project-local rust-analyzer configuration that redirects its cargo check build artifacts to a separate target/ra directory to avoid lock contention and cache invalidation with regular cargo builds.

nodes.name: sidecar-entitlements.plist
nodes.summary: Minimal macOS hardened-runtime entitlements file granting only network client access, applied to bundled sidecar binaries distinct from the main app's broader entitlement set.

nodes.name: tauri.conf.json
nodes.summary: Primary Tauri application configuration for ORGII: defines the frontend build/dev commands, main window (1200x800, transparent, overlay titlebar), a strict CSP, the fs/deep-link/updater/shell plugin settings, and bundle/icon/updater endpoint configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: CSP explicitly allows 'wasm-unsafe-eval' and ipc:/asset: schemes needed for Tauri's IPC bridge and CodeMirror's nonce-scoped inline styles.

nodes.name: tauri.macos.conf.json
nodes.summary: macOS-specific Tauri config override supplying bundle resources, the entitlements.plist reference, code-signing identity, and minimum macOS version for the .app bundle.

nodes.name: tauri.windows.conf.json
nodes.summary: Windows-specific Tauri config override adjusting the main window's decorations and transparency (non-transparent, native decorations) and bundle resources for the Windows build.
